g1.label: 1. Land of hot ___
g1.why: The Southwest is known for its hot deserts, not oceans or forests.

g2.label: 2. Many people live in small ___
g2.why: The text describes people living in small towns, not big cities.

g3.label: 3. A rich ___
g3.why: The text says the Southwest has a rich history shaped by Native American and Mexican cultures.

g4.label: 4. A famous ___ model
g4.why: “Role model” is the fixed phrase describing Ellen Ochoa, not “rope” or “rose”.

g5.label: 5. She ___ young people
g5.why: The text says Ochoa inspires young people to work hard, not ignores or invents them.

g6.label: 6. The Grand ___
g6.why: The text names the famous Grand Canyon, not a camera or candle.

g7.label: 7. The warm ___
g7.why: Tourists come to enjoy the warm weather, not a window or wallet.

g8.label: 8. A popular ___
g8.why: The Grand Canyon has become a popular destination for holidays.

g1.label: 1. I ___ lived in Arizona
g1.why: The subject ‘I’ takes ‘have’ in the present perfect, not ‘has’.

g2.label: 2. She ___ visited the Grand Canyon
g2.why: He/she/it takes ‘has’ in the present perfect, not ‘have’.

g3.label: 3. We have known each other ___ 2019
g3.why: ‘Since’ introduces a specific starting point in time; ‘for’ introduces a duration.

g4.label: 4. They have lived here ___ ten years
g4.why: ‘For’ introduces a duration of time; ‘since’ introduces a starting point.

g5.label: 5. Ellen Ochoa ___ inspired
g5.why: He/she/it takes ‘has’ in the present perfect.

g6.label: 6. I have ___ been to New Mexico
g6.why: ‘Never’ (= not at any time) is the standard present perfect word for talking about experience.

g7.label: 7. He has worked in the same town ___ he was young
g7.why: ‘Since’ introduces the starting point of the action, not a duration like ‘for’.

g8.label: 8. Have you ___ eaten Mexican food?
g8.why: ‘Ever’ is used in present perfect questions asking about experience.
